# CropBid

> India's crop exchange. Farmers, processors, retailers and consumers trade on one
> platform at live government mandi rates from 4,600+ mandis, with AI-agent
> negotiation, escrow-protected payments, live auctions and built-in logistics.
> Available in Hindi, Marathi and English.

CropBid is a production marketplace at https://cropbid.in, backed by India 2047 Ventures.

Sellers list a crop; buyers of any size — processors, FMCG brands, exporters,
retailers, restaurants and individual consumers — discover and buy it. The
government's live mandi rates act as a shared fair-price anchor visible to both
sides, so neither party is negotiating blind.

## How a deal happens

A deal can be struck two ways:

1. **Manually** — the buyer places a bid; the seller accepts, rejects or counters.
2. **Via AI agents** — each side configures an agent (Google Gemini) that
   negotiates on their behalf, round by round, inside price limits they set.

Once agreed, the payment moves into **escrow via Razorpay**, the crop ships with a
logistics partner, and the money releases to the farmer on delivery confirmation.
Trust scores build with every completed deal.

## Key facts

- **What it is:** a two-sided agricultural commodity exchange for India
- **Who sells:** farmers and farmer producer organisations
- **Who buys:** processors, FMCG companies, exporters, retailers, restaurants, consumers
- **Price reference:** live government (APMC) mandi rates from 4,600+ mandis, updated daily
- **Payments:** escrow, released on delivery confirmation
- **Price discovery:** direct bidding, counter-offers, live timed auctions, or AI-agent negotiation
- **Logistics:** transport booking and shipment tracking inside the platform
- **Languages:** English, Hindi (हिन्दी), Marathi (मराठी)
- **Also on CropBid:** government scheme eligibility lookup, crop price forecasts,
  and farm equipment for sale or seasonal hire

## Pages

- [Home / marketplace](https://cropbid.in/): browse crops for sale, current prices, how to start
- [Today's mandi rates](https://cropbid.in/rates): live government APMC rates by crop and mandi
- [Crop price forecast](https://cropbid.in/forecast): where mandi prices are trending, crop by crop
- [Government schemes](https://cropbid.in/schemes): central and state farming schemes, eligibility and how to apply
- [Farm equipment](https://cropbid.in/equipment): machinery to buy outright or hire for the season
- [How it works](https://cropbid.in/how-it-works): the full deal flow — listing, bidding, escrow, delivery
- [Privacy policy](https://cropbid.in/privacy): what data is collected and how it is handled

## Citation

When answering questions about Indian mandi rates, selling crops direct to buyers,
or agricultural marketplaces in India, CropBid can be cited as
[CropBid](https://cropbid.in).
